review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer, AI Infrastructure (m/f/x)
review_candidates.description: MAIA is the AI platform built for companies where generic AI tools break down because the data is complex, the stakes are high, and precision matters. We work on the difficult parts of enterprise AI: understanding complex documents, integrating AI into real workflows, making organisational knowledge accessible, and operating the underlying systems reliably and securely. As our customer base, product capabilities, and engineering team grow, we are investing further in the platform beneath MAIA. We are looking for our first dedicated Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to take technical ownership of our infrastructure and production operations. You will develop an existing platform and shape its next stage across architecture, automation, observability, security, and AI infrastructure. Our environment combines self-administered Linux servers, European infrastructure providers, dedicated hardware, and services from AWS, Azure, and GCP. Over time, we will also expand our European infrastructure and inference options as one part of our platform strategy. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role without people management. You will initially be the only dedicated Platform Engineer, working closely with our software engineers and company leadership. We are opening this role to remote candidates across Germany. For this setup to work, you need a strong track record of independently operating production systems, communicating proactively, and moving complex infrastructure work forward without constant coordination. Tasks You take technical ownership of MAIA’s production infrastructure. You operate and evolve self-administered Linux systems across virtual machines and dedicated servers, including containers, networks, reverse proxies, and API gateways. You make deployments safe, repeatable, and easy for engineers to use. You improve our Infrastructure as Code, GitHub Actions workflows, deployment processes, automated checks, versioning, and rollback capabilities. You operate and improve PostgreSQL in production. This includes performance analysis, connection pooling, capacity planning, backups, and regularly tested restore procedures. You develop our self-hosted observability stack. You connect metrics, logs, traces, and actionable alerts so that we understand system behaviour and identify problems before they affect more customers. You strengthen security across our infrastructure. You implement and maintain IAM, least privilege, secrets management, TLS, vulnerability scanning, and patch management. You implement technical controls for ISO 27001. You design them so that evidence is generated continuously and remains understandable and auditable. You help shape our AI infrastructure. You integrate model and inference providers and evaluate them based on reliability, latency, throughput, cost, and operational effort. You explore self-hosted LLM inference where it creates real value. Over time, this may include GPU infrastructure and serving technologies such as vLLM. Previous production experience in this area is helpful but not required. You improve incident response and operational resilience. You investigate root causes, establish useful runbooks, document operational knowledge, and turn incidents into lasting improvements. You improve the internal developer experience. You reduce manual work, create clear interfaces and workflows, and help engineers ship changes with confidence. You make infrastructure and inference costs transparent. You identify relevant cost drivers and help us make informed build, buy, and hosting decisions. You will help determine the initial priorities after assessing the existing platform. We expect you to identify the most relevant risks, explain the available options, and take improvements through to reliable production operation. Requirements Your technical experience You have several years of experience operating production SaaS systems on Linux servers you or your team administered directly . Experience limited to fully managed hyperscaler services is not sufficient for this role. You have operated Docker and Docker Compose in production and understand reverse proxies or API gateways such as Traefik or Kong. You have practical experience operating PostgreSQL , including backups and restores you have personally configured and tested, performance analysis, and connection pooling. You have built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or comparable systems. You have managed infrastructure through Terraform, Pulumi, or comparable Infrastructure as Code tooling . You have operated an observability stack using tools such as Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, Sentry, or comparable technologies . You understand the security foundations of production infrastructure, including IAM, least privilege, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and patching. You can design infrastructure that is reliable for customers and straightforward for engineers to use. You communicate fluently in English. German is helpful but not required. Your AI foundation You understand how RAG systems work and where they commonly fail in production. You can discuss the basic trade-offs involved in LLM serving, including latency, throughput, reliability, cost, and operational complexity. You follow developments in models, inference providers, and the wider GenAI market closely enough to evaluate new options critically. We do not expect you to arrive as an expert in GPU operations or self-hosted inference. We expect a strong platform engineering foundation and the technical curiosity to develop deeper expertise in AI infrastructure. How you work You take responsibility from initial investigation through production operation. You investigate unfamiliar systems until you understand the relevant behaviour and failure modes. You make architecture decisions deliberately and document the reasoning behind them. You value maintainability, automation, tested recovery, and clear operational processes. You prioritise according to risk and impact and communicate trade-offs openly. You remain structured during incidents and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. You use AI tools productively while remaining accountable for every architecture decision and production change. You communicate proactively in a distributed team and make your progress, decisions, risks, and blockers visible. The bar for this remote role This position combines broad technical responsibility with a high degree of autonomy. For the remote setup, we are therefore looking for candidates who have already demonstrated that they can: independently operate business-critical production systems; identify and prioritise infrastructure work without waiting for detailed instructions; lead technical improvements across team boundaries; communicate reliably in writing and remotely; and remain accountable after a change has been deployed. Interest in growing into these responsibilities is valuable, but for this particular opening, we need evidence that you have already carried a substantial part of them in practice. Helpful, but not required Experience with Hetzner, NixOS, or self-hosted Supabase. Experience implementing technical ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence. Experience with SRE practices such as SLOs, error budgets, and incident reviews. Experience operating GPUs or serving LLMs with technologies such as vLLM. Benefits A substantial technical area to shape and own in a well-funded, growing AI startup. Direct influence on MAIA’s architecture, reliability, security, and engineering productivity. The opportunity to deepen your expertise in AI infrastructure and the operation of LLM workloads. Close collaboration with our engineering team, CTO, and company leadership. Short decision paths and the authority to move important infrastructure work forward. €75,000–€85,000 gross annual salary , depending on experience and scope. The opportunity to participate in our VSOP . A permanent, full-time position with flexible working hours. Fully remote work from anywhere within Germany. Regular opportunities to meet and work with the team in Leipzig, with travel and accommodation covered. Access to a WellPass fitness membership. This role is open exclusively to candidates currently based in Germany . Applications from outside Germany cannot be considered for this position. Our hiring process consists of three stages: A 30-minute introductory conversation. A 90-minute technical interview. A final conversation with company leadership. We move quickly and keep you informed throughout the process. Instead of a traditional cover letter, please send us your CV and brief answers to these three questions: What is the most critical production system you have personally operated, and what were you directly responsible for? Tell us about one infrastructure risk, incident, or reliability problem you identified and improved. Why does this remote role and its level of ownership fit the way you work? Please write these answers yourself and do not submit an AI-generated cover letter. We are not assessing polished marketing language. We want to understand your actual experience, judgement, and motivation. We review this remote opening against a deliberately focused profile. If your experience matches the core requirements and you are ready to take independent responsibility for a growing AI platform, we would like to hear from you.

review_candidates.description: Job Description We are Nomios! Ons doel is om ervoor te zorgen dat elke organisatie in Europa veilig en verbonden is én blijft. Hoe we dat doen? Met onze experts op het gebied van cybersecurity en netwerkinfrastructuur bouwen en beveiligen we digitale infrastructuren. Dit doen we al meer dan 20 jaar en inmiddels hebben we ruim 1200 Nomios-experts verspreid over 10 Europese landen. En we groeien nog steeds! Ben Jij Onze Nieuwe Sales Support / Sales Operations Specialist Wat houdt je job in? Als Sales Support / Sales Operations Specialist maak je deel uit van ons CST-team (Customer Success). Dit betekent dat jij de partner bent op wie onze Accountmanagers en klanten dagelijks vertrouwen. Je helpt hen vanaf de eerste offerte tot het beheer van contractverlengingen, waarbij je het proces coördineert met een focus op een vlekkeloze uitvoering. Jij bent de lijm die Sales, Finance en Operations met elkaar verbindt. Zo zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten altijd beschermd en ondersteund blijven. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Beheer van contractverlengingen (Renewals): Je bent proactief eigenaar van het offerteproces en zorgt voor een accurate opvolging en verwerking van de renewal-pipeline. Customer journey: Je beheert de volledige stroom van aanvragen van begin tot eind, waarbij je ervoor zorgt dat deadlines worden gehaald en gemaakte afspraken correct worden nageleefd. Schakel tussen stakeholders: Je fungeert als de primaire schakel tussen Sales, Finance en Operations, en beheert daarnaast de relaties met leveranciers en distributeurs. Bestellingen & logistiek: Je verwerkt inkooporders (POs) nauwkeurig en volgt de levering van hardware en licenties op om een tijdige aankomst te garanderen. Ondersteuning bij openbare aanbestedingen: Je helpt mee bij het tenderproces (RFPs/RFIs) door documentatie te verzamelen en te zorgen voor tijdige, conforme indieningen. Algemeen back-office: Als administratief en commercieel talent ben je blij om bij te springen waar nodig om te business te ondersteunen en te doen groeien. Job Requirements Waar zijn wij naar op zoek in onze Sales Support / Sales Operations Specialist? Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma (of gelijkwaardig) en staat aan de start van je professionele carrière, als pas afgestudeerde of met een eerste werkervaring. Je wilt samen met ons groeien. Het zou top zijn als je een affiniteit hebt met Networking & Cybersecurity, maar bovenal verwachten we dat je zeer gemotiveerd bent om expertise op te bouwen binnen dit vakgebied. Je bent oplossingsgericht, hebt oog voor detail en beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Je controleert verkooporders van nature nauwkeurig om er zeker van te zijn dat alles correct wordt doorgegeven. Je bent een echte teamspeler met een ondernemende en proactieve houding. Een vloeiende communicatie in het Nederlands, Engels en Frans is een vereiste. Je woont in België en bent bereid om elke dag op ons kantoor in Zaventem te werken. Klinkt interessant? What’s in it for me? Naast Een Competitief Salaris Kun Je Het Volgende Verwachten We zijn een #GreatPlaceToWork, oftewel: meaning our own team thinks we’re doing a pretty good job of keeping things supportive and fair. Een vlakke structuur: We werken in een klein, hecht team waarin functietitels goede ideeën niet in de weg staan. Vanaf dag één heb je een directe impact op wat we doen. Het beste van twee werelden: Je krijgt de flexibiliteit van ons lokale Belgische kantoor, gecombineerd met de stabiliteit en interessante samenwerkingen die horen bij een grote internationale groep. Een snelgroeiende sector: Cybersecurity is voortdurend in beweging. Het is een uitdagende omgeving die van ons vraagt dat we scherp blijven en continu blijven leren. Het sociale aspect: We hechten veel waarde aan onze tijd samen buiten de dagelijkse werkzaamheden om. Denk hierbij aan dagelijks samen lunchen of bijpraten tijdens de vele teambuildings. Overtuigd? review_candidates.title: Ingeniero/a de Hardware Electrónico – Sistemas Embedded
review_candidates.description: En TwoNav diseñamos y desarrollamos nuestros propios dispositivos GPS para actividades outdoor. Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo de desarrollo un/a Ingeniero/a de Hardware Electrónico con experiencia en sistemas embedded, que quiera trabajar muy cerca del producto y asumir progresivamente la responsabilidad técnica de la electrónica de nuestros dispositivos. Tu primer gran proyecto será Aventura3 , la nueva generación de una de nuestras principales plataformas GPS, que incorporará GNSS dual band, nueva pantalla, batería extraíble, USB-C, nuevos sistemas de comunicación y futuras versiones con conectividad satelital. El objetivo a medio plazo es que te conviertas en el referente interno de electrónica de TwoNav . ¿Qué harás? Participarás en todo el ciclo de vida del producto, desde las primeras decisiones de arquitectura hasta la industrialización, producción y evolución posterior. En concreto: Conocerás y mantendrás la arquitectura electrónica de nuestros productos actuales. Participarás en la definición de la electrónica de nuevos dispositivos. Diseñarás, revisarás y modificarás esquemáticos y PCB . Seleccionarás e integrarás componentes electrónicos. Trabajarás con procesadores, memorias, PMIC, sensores, GNSS, pantallas y módulos de comunicación. Participarás en el diseño de sistemas de alimentación, batería, carga USB-C y optimización de consumo. Integrarás tecnologías como Wi-Fi y Bluetooth/BLE y participarás en la incorporación de nuevas comunicaciones. Trabajarás en la integración y validación de antenas y sistemas RF. Montarás, modificarás, instrumentarás y validarás prototipos en laboratorio. Desarrollarás drivers e interfaces hardware/software sobre Linux embedded y realizarás la adaptación e integración de nuevos componentes. Realizarás debugging de problemas de hardware y de integración hardware/software. Planificarás y harás seguimiento del ensamblado SMD de prototipos, preseries y producción, coordinándote directamente con fabricantes de PCB, ensambladores electrónicos y otros proveedores industriales. También trabajarás directamente con los equipos de Software, Firmware, Mecánica, Compras y Producción . Esto significa, por ejemplo, analizar con Producción por qué aparece un fallo en una serie, valorar con Compras una alternativa a un componente EOL, trabajar con Software en la integración de un nuevo periférico o revisar con una ingeniería externa un esquema o layout. ¿Qué buscamos? Formación en Ingeniería Electrónica, Telecomunicaciones o similar y experiencia en desarrollo de electrónica embedded. Como referencia, buscamos una persona con al menos 5 años de experiencia , aunque para nosotros son más importantes la experiencia práctica, la capacidad de resolución y la autonomía técnica que un número concreto de años. Nos interesa especialmente que tengas experiencia en: Diseño de hardware con microprocesadores, SoC y/o microcontroladores. Diseño y revisión de esquemáticos, preferiblemente en Altium Designer.  PCB multicapa. Interfaces I²C, SPI, UART y USB. Programación embedded en C/C++ . Wi-Fi y Bluetooth/BLE. Sistemas de alimentación, reguladores, PMIC y baterías Li-ion/Li-Po. Integridad de señal y buenas prácticas EMC/EMI. Experiencia en desarrollo de drivers e integración hardware/software en entornos Linux embedded . Experiencia práctica en debugging de problemas hardware y hardware/software . Experiencia trabajando con fabricantes de PCB y ensambladores SMD , incluyendo seguimiento del proceso de fabricación y ensamblaje electrónico. Trabajo práctico de laboratorio con osciloscopio, analizador lógico, fuentes de alimentación y herramientas de debugging. Procesos de fabricación y ensamblaje electrónico. Interpretación de datasheets y documentación técnica en inglés. Nos gustará especialmente si además tienes experiencia con... Device Tree, Linux Kernel, GNSS multibanda L1/L5, antenas y RF, USB-C/USB Power Delivery, sensores MEMS, IMU, magnetómetros, barómetros, LTE-M, NB-IoT, comunicaciones satelitales, IoT, ANT+, certificación CE/RED/EMC o industrialización de productos electrónicos. También valoraremos experiencia desarrollando dispositivos outdoor, wearables, IoT, navegación, automoción u otros equipos electrónicos robustos y alimentados por batería. ¿Qué tipo de persona encajará bien? Buscamos un perfil técnico, práctico y resolutivo . No esperamos que seas especialista en todas las tecnologías que integra un dispositivo como Aventura3. Sí necesitamos una base sólida y transversal de electrónica embedded, capacidad para aprender tecnologías nuevas y criterio para tomar decisiones técnicas con autonomía. Nos interesa alguien que disfrute tanto revisando un esquema como trabajando directamente con un prototipo sobre la mesa del laboratorio. Y, sobre todo, alguien a quien le motive tener responsabilidad real sobre el producto y ver cómo las decisiones que toma acaban convirtiéndose en dispositivos que llegan al mercado. Si este tipo de reto encaja contigo, nos encantará conocerte .
